title: Leadership and Change Management
summary: Project management, governance, ROI, named change-management frameworks (Kotter, ADKAR, Lewin), and the ethics of telling clinicians what to do. The module that turns a fellow into a CMIO.
learningOutcomes: Run a clinical informatics project through a recognized PM framework and explain the choice.
Design an informatics governance structure for a real organization and defend the trade-offs.
Build an ROI case for an informatics intervention without lying with numbers.
Compare Kotter, ADKAR, and Lewin's change models and pick the right one for a scenario.
Articulate the ethical responsibilities of an informaticist who is also a clinician.
